disorder-name.detail: Psychosis spectrum group; defined via dimensional psychosis measures (SIPS/PS-R scores ≥2 SD above age-matched peers, GOASSESS psychosis items, or PS-R threshold) in PNC cohort, and DSM-IV first episode psychosis confirmed by SCID in the Pitt cohort

dataset-of-origin.detail: Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC, N=162) obtained via dbGaP, and a local University of Pittsburgh Conte Center cohort for first episode psychosis (Pitt, N=32)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Three data sets were acquired at the University of Pittsburgh and one at the University of Pennsylvania (28, 29)."
dataset-of-origin.location: Jalbrzikowski2019.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L33-L35; appi.ajp.2018.18040443.ds001.pdf.md: Supplemental Methods / PNC and Pitt sections

age.detail: Combined from Philadelphia/PNC (N=162, mean=16.0, SD=2.9, range 10–22) and Pitt (N=32, mean=20.8, SD=3.1, range 12–25). Weighted mean=(162×16.0+32×20.8)/194=16.79 (weighted); pooled SD=sqrt((161×8.41+31×9.61)/192)=2.93 (pooled).
age.supporting_text: "Philadelphia: 10–22, N=162, Mean=16.0, SD=2.9; Neurodevelopmental Cohort Pitt: 12–25, N=32, Mean=20.8, SD=3.1" [Psychosis Spectrum Group columns]
